sentences.en: It's so muggy outside today—I'm sweating already.
sentences.ko: 오늘 밖이 너무 후덥지근해서 벌써 땀이 나.

sentences.en: The rain caught me off guard without an umbrella.
sentences.ko: 우산도 없는데 갑자기 비가 와서 완전히 당황했어.

sentences.en: I love going for a walk in cooler evening weather.
sentences.ko: 선선한 저녁 날씨에 산책하는 게 너무 좋아.

sentences.en: Do you think it'll clear up by this afternoon?
sentences.ko: 오늘 오후쯤엔 날씨가 맑아질 것 같아요?

sentences.en: We had to call off the picnic because of the rain.
sentences.ko: 비 때문에 소풍을 취소할 수밖에 없었어.
